pages.text: Choose carefully: you pick your race once, at character creation, and it $(bold)cannot be changed.$()$(br2)Races modify secondary stats only; HP% and damage% belong to classes. A build gets its identity from race and class together, so the same class played by two different races feels quite different.

pages.title: The Eleven Races (1/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Human$(): versatile, with the fastest leveling.$(li)$(bold)Elf$(): fast, fragile, night-adapted.$(li)$(bold)Dwarf$(): slow, hardy, fire-resistant, mining mastery.$(li)$(bold)Orc$(): high attack speed, hunger drain and knockback.$(li)$(bold)Halfling$(): lucky and efficient, with a small hitbox.$(li)$(bold)Faefolk$(): nature-attuned, slow fall, an iron weakness.$(li)$(bold)Revenant$(): undead, weak in sunlight, strong at night.

pages.title: The Eleven Races (2/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Demi-God$(): +40% HP, raw-meat healing, strength and phase abilities. Mild Nether weakness.$(li)$(bold)Ryu$(): draconic. 25% damage reduction, slow fall, clears debuffs.$(li)$(bold)Fallen Angel$(): +15% all damage, slow fall, dash. Fragile (-20% HP).$(li)$(bold)Kirin$(): fast; wall-climb, sprint-jump, night vision. Fragile (-20% HP).$(br2)$(bold)Next: read each race's own page.$()
